description: This file defines a ProcessRunner class and related functions for managing inter-process communication, process lifecycle, and profiling in the Playwright testing framework. It handles messages, requests, and responses between processes, including graceful shutdown and environment variable tracking.

classes.name: ProcessRunner
classes.description: A class managing process communication, including dispatching events, sending requests, and handling process lifecycle.

methods.name: gracefullyClose
methods.description: Asynchronously attempts to gracefully close the process.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event to the parent process with a specified method and parameters.

methods.name: sendRequest
methods.description: Sends a request to the parent process and awaits a response.

methods.name: sendMessageNoReply
methods.description: Sends a message to the parent process without expecting a reply.
